senses.zh_definition: 我；文献中作为 aku 的非标准变体出现，用于说话者自称。
senses.en_definition: I; me: an attested nonstandard variant of aku, referring to the speaker.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku bagi aku yang ditemukan dalam sumber bertulis, merujuk kepada diri penutur.
senses.nuances: 《Mider ing Rat》明确将 haku 注释为 aku（bahasa Melayu），支持这一有限释义，但不能据此认定其为马来西亚标准词或限定其方言分布。[文献依据](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Mider_ing_Rat.pdf)。本条马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 官方释义；词性实际为代词，因此使用 pronoun。下列短语和对话为说明性自拟示例，未经语料频率验证。

etymology.historical_story: A note in Mider ing Rat identifies haku as Malay aku, offering a documented connection rather than a verified history of the initial h. Aku belongs to an ancient Austronesian pronoun family reconstructed as *aku. This background supports comparison with aku, but does not establish when or where haku developed, or whether its spelling represents a particular pronunciation. [Literary source](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Mider_ing_Rat.pdf); [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/24792).
